d: The Rockets defeated the Thunder, 119-98 tonight in Houston. Jabari Smith Jr. contributed a team-high 30 points to go with 9 rebounds 6 three pointers and 5 assists, with Marcus Smart of the Rockets adding an additional 24 points (7-10 FG, 7-10 3P) and 24 points in the game. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander finished with a team-high 26 points along with 4 rebounds for the Thunder in the losing effort. The Rockets improve their record to 6-1 with the win, while the Thunder fall to 4-2 for the season.
